Age of donor is not a huge issue since most transplants don't last much past 15 years or so (some variation based on the organ in question; lungs generally go quicker than kidneys for example). Even with antirejection meds, the immune system does far more damage than simple aging for them. Kids who receive transplants will require revision if they live long enough.

TLDR; Chika might be first to die

I love that psycho/yandere Ami is confirmed now. I also like how many theories that people have had before are slowly being confirmed, and kind of have my own long shot theory about Ami.

Since she's killed before, ("butchered" definitely means killed in this context) then the top 3 candidates for Ami to go after would be Chika, Ayane, and Maya, in that order. I figured Ayane would be number one months ago when i assumed correctly that Ami was a yandere, because of Ayane's obnoxious love for Akira, the lost child, and how Ami reacted to finding out that Ayane knew of the true relationship between Ami and her uncle, but .31 makes me think that Chika might be first. That's definitely how things seem to be lining up. There's already a high chance that Chika will end up in the new apartment complex with Akira, either a few doors down like Touka mentioned, or maybe his exact unit. But now there's the likelihood that she'll end up working at the maid cafe that he frequents regularly, putting her in close proximity with Akira on a regular basis. I think it might be plausible that Ami and Chika might have a confrontation at the maid cafe while both trying to cater to Akira and Ami goes overboard, resulting in Chika quitting on the spot out of anger and not being able to work with Ami. (It's a long shot I know, but I feel like it's plausible.) Chika has already spoken of how she thinks that Ami loves her uncle a little too much multiple times, and due to Ami's rebuttals and other statements regarding it and around the time that Chika has spoken out, has left Chika in a less than stellar moods on occasion, as we saw in this update as well. I feel like these multiple occurrences and verbal clashes have been building up to something, and I believe Chika's soon to be employment at the maid cafe will exasperate things further. If Chika quits on the spot like I mentioned earlier, that of course wouldn't sit right with Akira, and he may demand Ami apologize for her actions at the cafe, not only because he thinks she's gone too far, but because it would put Chika and Chinami's well being in jeopardy. That might be the final bit needed to make them move into the new complex since Chika would be out of a job and have no way of keeping Chinami safe and a roof over their heads.
With all of that said, I can't think of a good way of Ami finding out that Chika's staying there, but her finding out coupled with her employment (proceeded by her unemployment) at the maid cafe would bring her to believe that Chika is purposely placing herself in places to be close to Akira. Finding out about the secret apartment along with this would lead her to speculate that either her uncle and Chika are secretly seeing each other, or that Chika's plotting exactly that. Since Ami has already heard of the resets from Makoto this reset and has shown signs of mentally/metaphysically cracking, I believe this Chika situation would be the fuse igniting that pushes Ami over the edge and get her to go after Chika.

That's not even mentioning that if she finds out about the secret apartment and Chika being there once she is, she'll more than likely find out in person at the complex by following Akira there (thought of a way for her to find out about the apartment that makes sense), leading her to also possibly finding out that Chinami sees him as a father figure and always calls him papa, making her believe that Chika is her lover replacement, and Chinami is her daughter figure replacement. Remember, she just went on an exposition about how if she's apart of Sensei, the same way organs are, that he could replace her just as he would an organ if it wasn't of use to him anymore/stopped working as intended/wasn't what he wanted anymore (whichever way she worked it), and asked if he'd replace her if that were the case. Although a long shot, that all would directly correlate with a lot of what we just saw this update.

Any thoughts?

Hi, long time lurker here. I've been enjoying your arguments and theories for a while holding back my urge to join in until now. Basically, because I'm certainly not good at crafting theories, more of an observer, constantly raising questions. It doesn´t help either that english is not my native language so I have to put double the effort in expressing my thoughts. So the time I'll spend here will be mostly sitting on the Dunce Table rather than the Plant Council.

But I said "fuck it" and share some thoughts (embrace yourselves because it's going to be long). We've had two big theories in here recently on why some girls are able to go through resets (pregnancy and being killed by amy), and when I first read about the pregnancy one I feel exactly the same like when I discovered the R+L=J in Game of Thrones, like "yeah! there's no way that's not it". The Ami one is cool, the kind of theory you just want to be truth.

And I feel they are not totally debunked if you combine them: Maya seems to think you gotta be pregnant in every reset to make it to the roof (which doesn't explain her situation, since she is allegedly not carrying a baby or related to Akira), but how about if they need to be pregnant just the first time and then a second condition is met: this being, getting killed by Ami. But since they are pregnant, the child is the sacrifice that allowed them to survive next resets. There have been some talks about sacrifices in the game. Also, Himawari is a external agent and one of the things she might be doing is precisely helping Ayane during the resets.

Now, I always wondered why aren't more girls getting pregnant, Akira is not shy in filling their wombs regularly. So here comes a crazy thought with 0.0001% of holding truth: there are specific resets in which specific girls are "ovulating" and ready to get pregnant. And how do you recognize them? Well, when they find glitches in the matrix... which means now Makoto is ready to be impregnated, something that's being heavily implied that will happen this update. It's a shame my fav girl Yumi missed her chance.

And that's a big reason of why I think Makoto will actually be the first Ami's victim (on screen). There are many other reasons tough:
- Ami always felt threatened by Makoto for some reason, she is identified as her enemy N°1 from the start.
- Makoto tried to kill herself multiple times unsuccesfully. Now, she's trying a different approach, being more relaxed and happy... yeah, that's not how things works in Kumon mi, you are asking for trouble.
- Makoto will be the one acting more suspiciously out of character this loop.
- She is doing tehrapy with Ami and even tough she's not stupid to outing herself, Ami will have many opportunities of reading her for the slightest slip of the tongue.
- She will spend a lot of time with the "traitors" Maya and Ayane. Ami will feel particularly aggravated by this betrayal since she is the one that helped her through the bad times.
- The girl killed must be "in the know", what's the point of killing an unsuspecting girl like Chika? I think Ami will try to erase someone that is actively trying to break the cycle.
- And well, if it does happen, would be the perfect oportunity to test all of our theories.

OOkay, I also want to get on this theory crafting going on (even if I am pulling this out of my a$$)

SO, for some reason while reading about the girls that are on the roof and why there is a checklist in some of the events, I thought of something and am n ow finishes "sort of" polishing it

what if there is a certain "list" of certain criteria that need to be present in order for the girls to get on the roof, and this list is exclusive for every single girl (or their desires), and once these requirements are met, they get tested whether or not they can see the "roof"

We also know that the loops start around the time Sensei ran away with Maya and when he started teaching but there is not enough solid evidence for me to connect it all, so Ill omit it for now

I think we can exclude sensei from it because he is technically the MC, but what about we start with the ones that are already on the roof

Maya: We dont know anything about her parents, guardians or, anything at all. So when she had sensei "choose" her, the GoDs saw her as a pivotal point in the story so she became a "anchor" of sorts for Sensei (as punishment or else). She was the starting point of this situation, and as she was around 12/13, her only probable desire was "to be someones N°1 priority" And as we dont know anything about her, her "desire" is already "sated" for now

Ayame: Neglectful Mother, Completely uncaring Father. She gets thrown to the side and left to the carte of a butler. No matter what she tries, she is constantly ignored by those she views as important (her family) to the point where she has to go look outside for any shred of affection. (iIRC there is an event where she breaks down in Senseis arms as he is the only one who "cares enough"). So, with these to things together, her "desire" could have been to have a "family of love" so, as her pregnancy happened, thet requirement for the roof sqad was met

and then there are the other girls

Makoto: A girl who, at the beginning, fighting tooth and nail to be seen as anything else than a smaller Maki. She forced herself to always get good grades, hates anything "erotic", goes out of her way to do anything to exclude herself from what she considers "like her mother". While she loved her father, she was well aware of the "open relationship" aspect going on with her parents, as well. So, at the start we just edge her and deny what she wants, so there wasnt any fault. But as the story progresses, we start treating her as he own person, are the for her (in our own way), care about her as "Makoto" and not "Maki's daughter", and show that she is not her mother. This is where her"checklist" completes and she is now on the "test for squad" range

Yumi: Ah, Yumi, Yumi, Yumi. where do I even start with you. every card is put against her. We know her father was a Yakuza but is pussy and a neglectful PoS, a mother who is an addict, She herself is point blank broke. She has so many walls. She cares for a select group of people but, with who she is, doesn't know how to express herself, and ends up always pushing people away, violently, to the point where very few even bother. my theory is that her "desire" is/was "break free of the past and become a better person". at the beggining, only looking for a job was a start, but before the "Yumiknows", we saw she was slowly breaking out, she actually tried this time, and with everything going for the better (reconect with cousin, chinami gewtting better, no more addict mom) her "checklist" became complete

there is also tsuneyo and sana that i omited, but I am still trying to piece all together, so i might come back to this later

posts.content_html_raw:
Thoughts on pairings/contests:

Yumi v Tsuneyo -- I don't see a way Yumi cares enough to win this. If anything, if she pretends to put her all into it and loses, it may cause some of the class to feel safer around her (knowing Tsuneyo can take her down at-will). Also, Tsuneyo is going to take this very seriously, and quite likely literally. Verdict: Yumi dies. Briefly. Nobody actually notices.

Chika v Uta -- Chika shows up in strategically placed dental floss. Uta slips into hyper-competitive mode and and changes quickly into her Birthday Bathing Suit. A fight breaks out, Yumi jumps in to defend her friend, Tsuneyo jumps in. Yumi dies again. Briefly. Nobody notices again.

Ayane v Yasu -- We don't hear from either of them again until search parties are sent to rescue them in the final chapters.

Sana v Otoha -- Otoha is creeped out by the contest and doesn't try. Wins anyway.

Makoto v Kirin -- Makoto understands the assignment and actually fishes. Kirin misunderstands the assignment, assumes "fish" is sexual, and wins a side-contest instead.

Miku v Io -- Io actually builds a raft. Miku points out that since she's flat AND a swimmer, she IS a raft.

posts.content_html_raw:
Finally, I got around to the new update, and to say that was a roller coaster of crazy would be putting it lightly.


On Ami -
It's nice to have it confirmed that she's the psycho killer we all knew she was, but I don't think her killing people is what awakens them to the reset. It's probably just the amount of trama the girls experience that allows them to become aware of the time shanagins. (Of course, Ami could definitely be the traumatic experience that wakes them up, so it's not much of a difference.)


On Maya -
I don't know why she decided to keep the bigist threat to everyone a secret, but she definitely earned the Big Silly Goose title on this one. I understand why she can't tell Akira since whenever she tries to tell him something, he breaks, but letting Ayane know would have been the smart thing to do. Still, it seems like it was mostly Makoto's fault on this one.


On Touka\Tsubasa -
I was impressed that Akira immediately came clean to Touka about the apartment situation. And she handled it well, but I still believe she's going to start resinating her mother soon. Tsubasa is a lot more perverse than I thought, and her trying to connect with her children is nice, but I'll still bet money that her Super Cool Help Chika Move Plan™ and Super Cool Have Touka Lose Her Verginaty Plan™ will both explode in her face.


On Rika -
The saddest, sillyst goober I've seen in LIL. I can't wait to get a threesome with her and Imani. (I can dream, goddamit.)


On Kaori -
Technically, nothing new on the Kaori front; still weird\adorable, and all that, but the Sekai possessions are new, and I wonder why she seems to favor Kaori all of a sudden.


On ??? -
On Nao - POSSIBLE NEW 5000 YEAR OLD WIZARED\GOD!!!! FUCK YEAH!!!!! In all seriousness, I'm 100% sure she's either the Clam god itself or, at the very least, deeply connected to them. My big piece of evidence is that she has the same skin color as Tsuneyo. Am I probably 100% wrong? Definitely. Does the basis of this theory make me somewhat racist? I hope not. But I like her and hope to see a lot more of her. A thing I noticed is that when Kaori was possessed by Sekai and Nao would get close, it would drive Sekai away. It's probably a coincidence, but who knows.

All the talk about Psycho Ami.

1) It's been established that Maya doesn't know as much as she thinks she does. The whole trial and error of why Ayane's started making it to the rooftop being an excellent example of that. She's identified a pattern, but she also has a very limited data set to work with, given that she has experienced exactly one cycle that didn't end within 3 resets and we're approaching our sixth.

2) She indicates that informing Ami of the resets always triggers her, but that simply means that in %100 of the instances where Psycho Ami appeared, Ami had found out about the resets. She may be falsely equating correlation with causation.

3) We have seen a steady drift on Ami's behavior towards dangerously obsessive behavior. The first invite-over scene for each girl tends to be more angry than the last, the Noriko closet scene, etc. This indicates a progression towards Psycho Ami is likely inevitable. A few things, and some of them are theories, to be clear. The comparison is mostly metaphorical.

This Ami is not the real Ami. I'm fairly certain the real Ami died in the accident, and Akira is too blinded by grief to realize this. Either something else has taken her form, or something is possessing her.

During Life of Prizes, we get a lot of information about the cuckoo that doesn't go anywhere. Granted, we get a lot of information in this game in general that doesn't go anywhere (120 pages on coffee beans), but the specific information about cuckoos felt like it had a "this is important" tag to it. Specifically -- mother cuckoos in many breeds do not keep their own nests. They instead visit another bird's nest after their eggs have been laid while the mother is a way and lays one egg in it. Cuckoo's pre-incubate their eggs before laying them, so this egg will hatch before any of the the others, and after hatching, the chick will push all the other eggs out of the nest, relying upon the mother's maternal instincts to get all the nurturing and sustenance for itself.

How does this relate to Ami? Ami is doing everything she can to keep the nest (harem) empty, and depending upon Akira's instincts to protect and nurture the last little bit of Sekai left in the world.

So when i say she's a cuckoo, I don't mean she's literally one, just that she's a not-entirely-human entity acting in a similar manner to one.

    • "Sla bz dhajo oly iylhr avnlaoly." - Let us watch her break together.
    • "Aol ulea zspkl pz tf mhcvypal." - The next slide is my favorite.
    • "Tpul hz dlss." - Mine as well.
    • "H zova myvt ilaaly khfz." - A shot from better days.
    • "Wyhpzl il." - Praise be.
    • "Ho, ovd dvuklymbs pa pz av il fvbun." - Ah, how wonderful it is to be young.
    • "Zol'z wylaaply dolu zol pz pu aol johpy." - She's prettier when she is in the chair.
    • "Fvb'yl zbjo h wlyc." - You're such a perv.

Overall: Not entirely sure what this could mean, but it's probably bad.

2 big reasons why the old portraits are worse than the new ones:
- The old portraits are wildly inconsistent, some of them are shot in the dark, some have weird lighting like Sana's portrait, Ayane and Ami are naked for some reason, Rin is crying in her portrait which is a big spoiler for someone new to the game, etc...
- Some of the new ones are more expressive of their personalities, not all but Maya and Miku are actually the 2 best examples. Sure we don't often see Maya in her shrine outfit but the outfit + blank stare in the new portrait expresses Maya's mysterious stoic vibe way better, compared to the old one which is just a random shot of Maya in the maid cafe. Same thing with Miku, the new one shows her energetic + athletic personality and the old one just looks like a random Koi character...

Also character growth and personality are two different things and character growth shouldn't affect personality most of the time. For example Ayane and Molly now are more mature, but still the same person and their portrait fits them in Chapter 3 as much as in Chapter 1. Changing profile pic between chapters would be a nice thing but not necessary. Between the weird rants and drms, Sel has already wasted enough time on dumb shit and I'd rather have him spending more time on the story
